definitions.explanation: The front of the chest seen as a flat, solid surface, usually when describing a strong, well-built man.

examples.japanese: {胸板|むないた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧。
examples.english: He has a broad, solid chest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍛|きた}えて→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧{胸板|むないた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{厚|あつ}く→厚い：00690_atsui⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to work out and build up my chest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{胸板|むないた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧。
examples.english: He used to swim, so he has a very broad chest.

notes:
Almost always with ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (broad, thick) or ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (thin), describing someone's build.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胸板|むないた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧: broad-chested
- ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧{胸板|むないた}: a broad, solid chest
- {胸板|むないた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: narrow-chested

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧: chest, breast — the general word; also the heart and feelings
